changeinfo.changes:
In addition to fixing various bugs, we've updated Sephiroth
(and his one wing) for smoother summoning. Enjoy!

We've added an oft-requested Theater Mode to the Title Screen and patched in an awesome new DLC Champion: Sora! Also, now you can restore HP/AP at most Gates. (But not the Main Gate or Exit Gates. Sorry!)

We've also crushed some bugs. CRUSH! They're gone! Happy imprisming!

In this update, we've paved the way for the next DLC Champion, Balthier!

You can now save your game at most Gates. (But still not the Main Gate or Exit Gates. Sorry!) In the Items menu, we've made it so you can use items a little more quickly by pressing the △ button. We've beefed up the Config menu by adding a new Fast-Forward setting and adding "Random" to the Battle Theme selections.

If you want, we've given you the power to skip Champion and Mega Mirage animations with the 〇 button, completely invalidating the work of dozens of artists with a single squeeze of your almighty, indifferent thumb.

And, of course, we've crushed some bugs. CRUSH! They're gone! Happy imprisming!
